summary: reCentre Health has 501 five-star reviews and real recovery stories, from ACL prehab to hip replacements. But Balham is crowded: a clinic across the road has 850 reviews, and another nearby is open until 9:15pm and on Sundays.
visibility: In our search for physiotherapy in Balham, several five-star clinics appeared side by side, including a much larger multi-site clinic directly opposite you. New patients compare quickly and pick whoever looks easiest to book.
lead: 501 five-star reviews with detailed surgery recovery stories.
Next-day appointments, an in-house gym and an exercise app.
Physio, osteopathy and Pilates under one roof.
lose: A nearby clinic is open until 9:15pm and on Sundays, which suits commuters.
A large clinic opposite you has more reviews, so it looks like the default choice.
Your surgery recovery expertise isn't obvious to someone searching after an injury.

gaps.title: Evening and Sunday patients go elsewhere
gaps.detail: Commuters searching after work or at weekends find clinics that are open. Online booking lets them reserve your next slot instead.

gaps.title: Surgery patients don't know you specialise
gaps.detail: Pre- and post-surgery rehab is where you shine, but someone searching 'ACL rehab Balham' can't see it.

gaps.title: Finished patients disappear
gaps.detail: Without follow-ups and Pilates offers after discharge, patients who loved you rarely come back for maintenance.

actions.title: Make surgery rehab a clear speciality

actions.title: Offer Pilates to discharged patients
actions.why: Doable today: an email to past patients keeps them with you for the long term.
